newsitem.title: USA: UtiliCorp files for six mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: UtiliCorp files for six mln share offering.

text.p: UtiliCorp United Inc said Monday it registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission a proposed public offering of up to six million shares of its common stock.

Proceeds of the transaction will be used to reduce short-term debt incurred primarily for acquisitions, construction and debt retirements, and for general corporate purposes, the company said in a statement.

The shares are expected to be offered in November 1996 through underwriters. Underwriters for the 5.25 million shares will be led by Merrill Lynch & Co., Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, Goldman, Sachs & Co, J.P. Morgan & Co Inc, and PaineWebber Inc. Underwriters also will have a 30-day option to purchase up to 750,000 additional shares to cover any over-allotments of shares.
Currently there are about 47 million shares of UtiliCorp common stock outstanding.
Utilicorp United is a $3.9 billion international electric and gas company with energy customers and operations in the United States, Canada, Great Britain, Australia, New Zealand and Jamaica.
